name: RunescapeDragonwilds-broccoli
description: A dedicated server for RuneScape: DragonWilds. The server files are downloaded with DepotDownloader on first start. Before you start: set OWNER_ID to your Player ID (at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu) and set ADMIN_PASSWORD. The server does not start without OWNER_ID. Forward UDP port 7777 on your router. The host port and the container port must be the same. If you change the port, also change DEFAULT_PORT. Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: UDP game port. Forward it on your router. The host port and the container port must be the same as DEFAULT_PORT.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Required. Your RuneScape: DragonWilds Player ID. Find it at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Required. Password to open Server Management in-game.

variables.name: Default World Name
variables.description: Name of the world created on first start.

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Optional password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players on the server.

variables.name: Default Port
variables.description: UDP port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Download and validate the server files on each start. Set to false to skip.
